required_steps: Use the existing Impact account tied to support@coshuma.com; do not submit another Omnisend application.
Open the approved Omnisend program in Impact and go to Content > Assets, matching Omnisend's official instructions.
Copy only the account-issued customer-facing tracking link. Do not copy a dashboard, onboarding, homepage, login, or generic Impact URL.
Verify that the tracking URL resolves to an official Omnisend customer landing page while retaining valid attribution behavior.
Only after verification, update Omnisend to approved_tracking and replace the current official-only Omnisend CTA where appropriate.
